sql: WITH events AS (SELECT block_timestamp, CAST(tokens AS DOUBLE) / 1e18 AS tokens, 'inflow' AS direction          FROM staking_legacy__stake_delegated          UNION ALL SELECT block_timestamp, CAST(tokens AS DOUBLE) / 1e18, 'outflow'          FROM staking_legacy__stake_delegated_locked          UNION ALL SELECT block_timestamp, CAST(tokens AS DOUBLE) / 1e18, 'inflow'          FROM staking__tokens_delegated          UNION ALL SELECT block_timestamp, CAST(tokens AS DOUBLE) / 1e18, 'outflow'          FROM staking__tokens_undelegated)          SELECT strftime(to_timestamp(block_timestamp), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date,          SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'inflow' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS inflows,          SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'outflow' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS outflows          FROM events WHERE block_timestamp >= 1720000000 AND block_timestamp < 1758000000          GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
